corpus.content_summary: Product is described as a 'decision-support tool' that 'estimates automation exposure and transition options from O*NET-centered occupation data, LLM-assisted task analysis, and commercial proof-pack workflows.' Does not predict job loss, make employment decisions, or certify scientific validity.

Homepage hero is search-first: occupation/skills input with quick filter chips (Market Map, Bright Outlook, STEM, Tech Skills). Primary CTA navigates to Career Impact Planner. Stores last search in localStorage. Tracks analytics events via PostHog.

B2B coach landing page promises: 'Generate Source-Labeled Automation Defense Audits' with white-label branding, O*NET-grounded analysis, evidence boundaries. Target: career counselors, executive coaches, resume writers. Pricing: $20/report PAYG or $149/mo Coach Pro.

B2C AI job risk calculator landscape is saturated: 12+ free competitors including WillRobotsTakeMyJob (2017, OG), AIJobImpactCalculator (ILO 2025 + Brookings + BLS + WEF), willitreplace.me (535 jobs), MeritForge AI (76 roles, MIT-licensed open data), Kairo (CLOSEST DIRECT COMPETITOR: task-level CV analysis, skill overlap, adjacent roles, free beta, knowledge workers), JobForesight (334 titles), JobSecurityMeter (resume-based), displacement.ai, OmniCalculator, TripleTen, JobReplacementAI, jobsdata.ai.

Enterprise workforce audit landscape is crowded: 8+ well-funded competitors including JobRoute (HRIS integration, SOC 2, version-locked 1,016 O*NET scores), INOP (BBRA framework, 40K+ roles, 7 research frameworks), Etter by Draup (task analysis, HRIS/ATS, SOC 2/GDPR/ISO 27001), RoleRisq (CSV→board-ready PDF in 48h, Anthropic Economic Index), Nexova (replaces $500K consulting, 60+ archetypes), Gloat (AI Impact Agent, 14 tools), EDLIGO (FTE impact), GoFIGR (free 3-min assessment, talent scout).

Veterans/military crosswalk landscape: O*NET Online Military Crosswalk (official, free), CareerOneStop Veterans Job Matcher (government, free), VeteranCareerPath.com (AI MOS translator, all 6 branches), SmartVeteran/Cadient (1,200+ MOS codes, NLP, ATS integration, 91% accuracy, B2B employer-facing), NextOp (end-to-end AI transition coach, 5 government data sources). Moderate competition; government tools are free but basic.

Coaching platform landscape: Coaching.com ($148-$2,485/mo, dominant white-label), BetterUp ($4K+/person/year enterprise), Sounding Board (~$28M revenue, B2B leadership), RapidDev (custom white-label builds at $13K-$25K). AI Career Coach Market: $5.48B (2025) → $6.69B (2026), 22.3% CAGR. 109,200+ coaches worldwide (ICF). No competitor offers O*NET-grounded white-label automation defense reports at $149/mo.

Competitor pricing benchmarks: Kairo (free beta), WillRobotsTakeMyJob (free, ad-supported), AIJobImpactCalculator (free), MeritForge AI (free + embeddable), JobRoute (enterprise, custom pricing), RoleRisq (free 30 days then paid), Nexova (paid plans), GoFIGR (free 3-min assessment + paid platform), Coaching.com ($148-$2,485/mo), BetterUp ($4K+/yr). Product's $29/mo Defender is competitive for B2C; $149/mo Coach Pro is significantly cheaper than Coaching.com ($148 minimum) while offering automation-specific features nobody else has.

User preferences: plan-first approach for non-trivial tasks, subagent strategy for context cleanliness, self-improvement loop after corrections, verification before done, demand elegance, autonomous bug fixing. Target audience defined as mid-career professionals (28-45), knowledge workers. Color direction: warm/grounded dark mode, teal/amber accents, NO purple. Messaging: empowerment + credibility, NO fear-based headlines.

Product has extensive verification infrastructure: 20+ npm verify scripts, Playwright E2E smoke tests (7 passing), commercial proof-pack verifiers, claim-boundary scanners, data-provenance checks, secret hygiene checks. All verification commands pass. However: $0 revenue, no live checkout proof, no live MRR, no paying customers, no partner outcomes. Product is code-complete but commercially unvalidated.
